title: Keeping a frog count consistent
titleZh: 維持青蛙觀察計數一致

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: For Sunday’s pond survey, count frogs you see, not calls you hear. If two people report a frog on the same stone at the same time, keep both notes but count one frog. Don’t merge two sightings just because the frogs look alike. Sightings at opposite ends of the pond at the same moment count separately. Write where and when you saw each frog. If you only hear a call, record it separately so we don’t confuse calls with sightings.
turns.zh: 週日的池塘調查請計算看到的青蛙，不是聽到幾聲蛙叫。如果兩人在同一時間都回報同一塊石頭上有一隻蛙，請保留兩筆紀錄，但只算一隻。不要只因蛙看起來相像，就把兩筆目擊合併。同一時間在池塘兩端各有目擊，就分開計數。記下每次看到蛙的地點和時間。若只聽見叫聲，請另記，以免把叫聲當作目擊。
